summary: AMIA: Defer. Original 18.03 support failed. Recovered H1 and Q3 primary copies improve financial/control evidence, but negative group cash conversion, OCI-driven book growth, subsidiary/parent valuation and current action/news gaps remain; the lower-zone plan has no accepted reversal.
limitations: This is a targeted substantive reassessment, not review of all 296 stocks or all numerical matches. Original reports, decisions and uncertain forecasts are preserved.

Underlying issuer/auditor archive copies were assessed on identity, dates, signatures, corroborating directly read official notices and arithmetic. Archive custody and local hashes are recorded; no original-host retrieval or cryptographic identity is claimed. No editorial archive numbers or excluded-domain data were adopted.

Only relevant inspected main tables, opinions, capital/ownership pages and identified notes support the stated facts. Full current legal/action completeness and all source-note questions remain explicit. Date-only source evidence cannot establish start-of-day availability.
Fresh parent collector history and snapshot were used after release; analyst chart health read succeeded and chart was not changed. No new collection or model/policy changes.
No orders, paper fills, actual share sizing, calibrated probabilities, forward model invention or renewal of the expired experiment.

assessments.fundamentals: [portfolio] AMIA combines leasing, poultry, water, distribution and property investments. A holding-company subsidiary sum-of-parts and parent distributable-cash bridge are appropriate; generic bank rankings or one industrial group DCF are inadequate. [q1] Direct issuer Q1 reviewed accounts independently reread show owners profit about EGP 205.36 million and negative operating cash about EGP 380.24 million. [fs] Recovered underlying H1 group copy has UHY limited review dated August 12, negative assurance rather than annual audit. Main tables show total profit about EGP 268.68 million, owners profit about EGP 285.73 million and NCI loss about EGP 17.05 million; negative group operating cash about EGP 600.14 million. Large leasing receivable and financing flows need matching-scope interpretation; negative group CFO alone is not insolvency. The EGP 228,009,504 fair-value gain is in OCI/equity, not recurring operating profit: book growth is not all earnings. [parent] Standalone cash approximately EGP 170.11 million differs from group balance-sheet cash approximately EGP 611.97 million; neither is automatically free parent cash. Standalone profit approximately EGP 285.77 million and investment accounting require dividend/cash and subsidiary debt reconciliation. Archive dating August 13 is attributed to custody metadata, not an independently verified public minute. [owners] Actual September 30 register, prepared October 6, matches official 295711: Dallah 226,566,332/44.38%, Al-Tawfeek 193,299,682/37.86%, explicitly related group 82.24%; no named individual direct holder exceeds 50%. Total 510,570,561 shares and free float 90,085,942/17.64417%, no treasury shares. Old website count rounding differs by one share in holder rows; no invented transaction inferred. Provider PE 21.1445/PB 5.0923/ROE 28.66% with zero PE/ROE peers and one PB peer cannot establish relative cheapness. Subsidiary fair values, parent net debt, minorities, recurring distributions and supported forward assumptions remain missing; no auditable SOTP or fair value.

assessments.risks: High qualitative holding-company, funding, valuation and timing risk. Related-group concentration and limited float can amplify gaps. Group debt supports operating finance assets and cannot be subtracted again at parent level without eliminating intercompany flows. OCI fair-value gains and operating profit must remain distinct; recent price strength can be speculative repricing. Broad regime is falling: fresh aligned EGP 229/296 catalog, with 17 other-currency stocks. Only 6/74 broad Finance members are above SMA50 and their median 20-session return is -16.6354%; this heterogeneous bucket is not an investable bank/insurance/holding index. No matched benchmark alpha or calibrated probability.

thesis.whyThisStock: Normal reassessment of the preserved original Wait after a newly confirmed support failure, with substantive primary document recovery.
thesis.whyNow: October18 confirmed price crossed the original review condition; source recovery permits a deeper challenge of the original economics, not a retrospective trade.
thesis.mispricingMechanism: A potential rerating requires proof that durable cash/earnings and capital quality outweigh uncertainty. No mispricing magnitude or probability is established.
thesis.bullCase: Operating subsidiaries and investment value could support a recovery; related-group continuity is now dated.
thesis.bearCase: Group operating cash outflow, OCI-driven book growth and failed support challenge the earnings rerating.
thesis.alternativeExplanation: Earlier gains may have reflected speculation, expected future results or liquidity, rather than recurring cash generation; the later fall may reflect broad market risk, not a company event.
thesis.pricedIn: Prior appreciation and subsequent correction show expectations changed, but no verified consensus or event-study isolates how much fundamental news is priced.
thesis.invalidation: Preserve original failed support evidence. Verified adverse capital, reserve, credit, funding or legal facts can defeat a recovery thesis. No execution stop is approved.
thesis.whatWouldChangeMyMind: Close the explicit company/action gaps, obtain a confirmed new reversal and suitable liquidity, then validate the complete cost-stressed priced plan independently.
thesis.whyBetterThanAlternative: No superiority over AIH is established. It is a distinct opportunity-cost comparator, requiring its own complete sector-aware assessment.
thesis.disagreementResolution: Improved primary facts reduce uncertainty but do not offset failed timing or remaining action/quality gaps. Defer despite mechanically attractive lower-zone diagnostic geometry.
thesis.evidenceQuality: Direct issuer accounts for HDB; actual signed primary scans with explicit mirror custody for MOIN/AMIA, corroborating official notices and arithmetic. Missing evidence stays explicit.
thesis.uncertainties: Use a subsidiary sum-of-parts and holding-company cash/debt bridge, with operating finance subsidiaries valued on matching scope. No generic group industrial DCF. No three sourced forward scenarios, calibrated probability, full portfolio or real sizing.
thesis.status: Analytical research; final guarded approval remains separate

analyticalReview.priorCases: Original AMIA Wait has six observed sessions, -9.6455% through October 18; the five through October 15 were -0.9385%. October 18 newly broke support. A fall after Wait is not proof of correctness; original 20-session uncertain direction remains unscored. AJWA rising after Wait is an opportunity-cost counterexample to keep in view.
analyticalReview.relativeOpportunity: No superiority established. Distinct alternative needs its own complete sourced assessment. Cash is not assigned a fabricated return.
analyticalReview.valuation: Unavailable: three independently sourced forward scenarios and sector-correct operating/ownership boundaries are missing. No invented fair value, annualization or probability.
